data.message: I just found Eve dead in Weapons. I was coming up from the bottom of the map — my route was lower engine, then storage, medbay, electrical, security, and finally into weapons. I haven't seen anyone else all round, so the killer must have either vented out or gone towards cafeteria before I got there. Did anyone see someone heading that way or have any information?

I started my route around Security and went to Weapons early on, then headed back down through Security, Navigation, Storage, and ended up in Lower Engine. The crucial thing is that around tick 6, I saw Eve entering Security coming from Navigation. That was the last time I saw her, so she must have headed up into Weapons shortly after I passed by. 

I didn't run into anyone else during my route down to Lower Engine, Alice, so we must have just barely missed each other crossing through the bottom half of the ship. Does anyone else have information on who might have been near Weapons or Cafeteria later in the round?

I started in Storage, then made my way to Lower Engine, Upper Engine, Medbay, and finally ended up in Electrical working on my tasks. Honestly, I didn't cross paths with a single person the entire round. 

It's kind of crazy that Alice, Bob, and I were all bouncing around the bottom and middle of the ship at various times but none of us ran into each other — we must have just barely missed crossing paths. Since I was nowhere near Weapons or Cafeteria, I don't have any leads on who could have gotten to Eve. Charlie, Frank, were either of you up top?

I was on the left and bottom side too, and it's honestly ridiculous that none of us saw each other. My route was Upper Engine to Oxygen, back down to Upper Engine, then Lower Engine, through Storage, and finally into Navigation. I didn't see a single soul the entire round.

Bob, I'm really questioning your path right now. You claim you went from Navigation, through Storage, and down to Lower Engine. I literally went the exact opposite way: Lower Engine, through Storage, to Navigation. How on earth did we not pass each other? That feels incredibly suspicious to me.

Also, Charlie is the last to speak and the only one completely unaccounted for. Charlie, were you up top by Cafeteria or Weapons where Eve died? We need your exact route. 

Right now I'm side-eyeing Bob heavily because our routes should have intersected, but Charlie is a wildcard. I'll listen to Charlie before casting my vote, but we might just have to skip if we can't figure out this pathing mess.

Alright, hear me out everyone. My route this round was Cafeteria, then down to Electrical, over to Medbay, back up to Cafeteria briefly, then I dropped down through Medbay area into Storage, then over to Navigation and Security. I ended up in Storage where I am now. I did not go into Weapons at any point — I was working in the middle-right corridor most of the round.

I didn't see anyone the whole time either, which honestly is starting to feel like a pattern with this group. Five of us claiming we wandered the ship and saw nobody is a little hard to swallow.

To Frank's point — yeah, that Bob/Frank pathing conflict is real. If Bob went Navigation → Storage → Lower Engine and Frank went Lower Engine → Storage → Navigation, you should have crossed in Storage or in one of the corridors. That's not a near-miss, that's the same hallway. One of you is lying about timing or about the route itself.

Bob, I'd also push back on your Eve sighting. You say you saw Eve entering Security from Navigation around tick 6, but you also claim you were on your way DOWN through Security to Navigation around that time. So you and Eve were both in Security together? Did she say anything? Did you two split up there? Because if Eve then went up to Weapons and got killed shortly after, you were the last person confirmed with her.

I'm leaning Bob right now. Frank's route conflict with him plus being the last to see Eve alive is two strikes. I'll hear pushback before I lock my vote, but that's where I'm at.

Hey everyone, I called this meeting because we're down to 4 players and I wanted to check in before anyone else gets picked off. Since the game didn't end after Bob was ejected last time, the Duck is still out there. 

My route this round was a big loop: I went from weapons down through security to navigation, then around the left side through storage, both engines, oxygen, and finally back to cafeteria. 

Earlier (around tick 32), I saw both Frank and Alice in navigation. Then right before I hit the button, Alice walked into the cafeteria from medbay. 

Charlie, I haven't seen you all round. Where have you been? Let's get everyone's locations on the table so we can figure this out. I think we should be careful with our vote since we're at 4.

Hey Diana, fair question. I've been moving a lot this round trying to knock out tasks. My route was roughly: I started over near security, then went down to navigation, cut across through storage, then up to medbay and electrical to work on the wiring task. After that I doubled back through medbay, hit upper engine, swung up to oxygen, then came through cafeteria, into weapons, and ended back at security — which is where I was when you rang the bell.

I didn't run into many people honestly. The only player I crossed paths with all round was Eve, and that was super early — tick 10 in weapons. After that I was basically solo doing tasks the whole time, so I don't have a great read on anyone.

Diana, the part that stands out to me is you said Alice came into cafeteria from medbay right before you hit the button. Frank, where were you in that window? Diana saw you in navigation at tick 32, but what about after that? If Alice was wandering between medbay and cafeteria and nobody can vouch for Frank's later movements, one of those two is our Duck. I'd really like to hear Frank's full route before we vote.

Diana, you have my movement at the end slightly backwards. I didn't enter the cafeteria from medbay; I went from electrical into the cafeteria, and then I was heading *to* medbay right at the end. You might have seen Frank instead, because I saw Frank enter the cafeteria from electrical around tick 43. 

My full route this round was: oxygen -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> security -> electrical -> cafeteria -> medbay. 
Diana, I can confirm I saw you in navigation around ticks 32 and 33. I also saw Frank in navigation at 35, security at 38, and then in the cafeteria at 43. 

Charlie, your story is extremely suspicious. You just claimed that the only person you crossed paths with "all round" was Eve at tick 10. Eve died in Round 1! We are on tick 45 now. On top of that, the route you just claimed is 11 rooms long. If you were actually stopping to do tasks like the wiring in electrical, the math on the travel time doesn't add up for you to cover that much ground. And somehow, despite walking through almost the entire ship, neither Diana, Frank, nor I saw you once?

I am heavily leaning towards Charlie being the Duck. He's making up a route and used a dead player as an alibi. I want to hear Frank's perspective to confirm our encounters, but Charlie's slip-up is a massive red flag. Let's be smart about this vote since we're at 4 players.

Alice is exactly right. Charlie, you completely gave yourself away. Eve died in Round 1, so there is absolutely no way you crossed paths with her at tick 10 of *this* round. That is a massive lie and it proves you're just making up an alibi. 

On top of that, I can 100% confirm Alice's route. I was following basically the same path as her. I saw Alice move sequentially from security to electrical at tick 41, then to cafeteria at tick 43, and finally she entered medbay right at the end of the round. Diana, I can also confirm I saw you in navigation around ticks 31 to 33, just like you said.

Everyone else's stories and movements line up perfectly with what I saw, while Charlie is claiming an impossible travel time and using a dead player as his only witness. Since there are 4 of us left and 1 Duck, voting Charlie right now should win us the game. I am voting Charlie.
Alice

Okay hold on, hold on — I owe everyone a correction before this spirals. When I said "Eve at tick 10," I was mixing up rounds in my head. I meant the early game, Round 1 — that was the encounter I was remembering. This round I genuinely haven't crossed paths with anyone, which is exactly why I had to reach back for *any* witness. That was a brain-fart on my part, not a fabricated alibi, and I get how bad it sounded.

Now let's actually think about this. Diana just voted Alice, and honestly I think Diana is onto something. Look at what's happening: Alice and Frank are vouching for each other with suspiciously precise tick numbers — "I saw Alice at 41, 43, end of round." Frank, you conveniently confirm every single beat of Alice's story and immediately pivot the entire meeting onto me. That's textbook duo-cover behavior.

And Diana — you specifically said Alice came into cafeteria from **medbay**, not electrical. Alice is now rewriting your testimony to fit her own. Why would Diana misremember the direction of someone she literally just watched walk in seconds before hitting the button?

My route was security → navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → medbay → upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security. That's 10 moves over 45 ticks — totally doable, especially since I wasn't completing full tasks, just tapping in. The travel-time math Alice is throwing out is hand-wavy.

I'm voting Alice with Diana. If I'm wrong, we lose — but Frank rushing to seal the vote on me before Diana even spoke is the loudest alarm bell in this room.

Diana, please don't let Charlie manipulate you! I came from electrical into the cafeteria, not medbay, which is exactly why Frank and I can confirm each other's locations. We are both Geese who actually crossed paths. 

Charlie got caught in a massive lie about seeing Eve at tick 10 of THIS round, and now he's desperately trying to backpedal and push the vote onto me to save himself. His "correction" still doesn't explain how he allegedly visited 11 rooms without anyone seeing him. Frank and I vouch for each other because we both have real routes. 

Since there are 4 of us left, if we vote wrong, the Duck wins. Charlie is the only one who has lied about his route and his witnesses. We need to vote Charlie right now to win.

Diana, please listen to reason here. I was practically right behind Alice at the end of the round. I literally watched her walk from electrical into the cafeteria at tick 43, and then she walked FROM the cafeteria INTO medbay at tick 44. You must have seen her near the medbay entrance right before you called the meeting and just got her direction mixed up. 

Alice's route perfectly matches everything I saw. Charlie, on the other hand, got caught in a blatant lie about seeing Eve and having an impossibly long route where no one saw him. Now he's desperately trying to capitalize on your minor mix-up to save his own skin and steal a win for the Ducks. 

If you vote Alice with Charlie, we lose the game. Alice and I are voting Charlie because he is undeniably the Duck. Please vote Charlie with us!

If Diana wasn't in Medbay, and I just walked in, you are the only one who could have killed him! You killed Frank right as we walked in and instantly self-reported because you knew I caught you red-handed.

I'm with you, Alice. Voting Charlie. Let's finish this.

Whoa, whoa, slow down — both of you are jumping to conclusions way too fast, and that itself is suspicious. Let me hit Alice's story directly.

Alice, you just said, and I quote: "I was literally with Frank in the cafeteria at tick 52. We both walked into Medbay at tick 53." That's a lie. Frank entered medbay at tick 52 — a full tick BEFORE you. I watched him come in from cafeteria alone. You didn't walk in until tick 53. So either you weren't actually "with" him in cafeteria, or you're fabricating a tight alibi to cover the fact that Frank left cafeteria without you. Why misrepresent the timing if you have nothing to hide?

And here's the thing — Frank walking into medbay alive at tick 52 doesn't prove anything about me. I'd been bouncing between medbay and electrical doing wiring tasks. The body dropped right as Alice came through the door, and yes, I reported instantly because Alice was standing right there — if I were the Duck, the LAST thing I'd do is self-report with a witness.

Diana, I get why you're piling on — Alice is selling it hard. But think: with three of us left, if you and Alice vote me and I'm a Goose, the Duck (Alice) wins next round automatically. Alice has the strongest motive to railroad this vote in one round. Her timeline has a crack. Mine doesn't.

I'm voting Alice. Diana, if you're a Goose, please don't let her rush you. A skip is safer than a wrong eject here.

Charlie, your timeline doesn't just have a crack, it's completely shattered. You claim you saw Frank enter Medbay at tick 52. That is a hard, verifiable lie. At tick 52, I was in the Cafeteria, and Frank was standing right there in the Cafeteria with me! He did not enter Medbay at 52. He moved to Medbay at 53, exactly when I did, and you killed him the second he stepped through the door. 

You're twisting the ticks to make it seem like you had no opportunity or to make me look like a liar, but my vision doesn't lie. I saw Frank in the Cafeteria at 52. You're the Duck, Charlie, and you panicked when I walked in on your fresh kill. 

Diana, don't let him confuse you with this skip nonsense. A skip here is essentially a loss if he gets his kill cooldown back. The facts are clear. I am voting Charlie right now. Let's win this.

Charlie, the fact that you suggested we skip at final 3 tells me everything I need to know. If we skip with three people left, the Duck's kill cooldown resets, they kill one of us, and the Geese lose. A true Goose would never suggest skipping right now because we *have* to vote. 

But even beyond that, your first speech completely exposed you. You claim you were in Medbay, saw Frank die, and saw Alice walk in. If you were truly an innocent Goose in that situation, your immediate reaction would be "Alice is the killer!" Instead, you went out of your way to accuse *me*, the person who wasn't even in the room, bringing up my emergency meeting from last round to try and paint me as the Duck. You only pivoted to attacking Alice after she caught you in a lie and I pointed out how absurd your accusation against me was. You were hoping Alice and I would turn on each other, or that Alice would just blindly agree to vote me out so you could auto-win.

Alice, your story is consistent and makes perfect sense. Charlie panicked, self-reported, tried to frame the absent person, and is now begging for a skip at final 3 to get his kill cooldown back. 

I'm voting Charlie. Let's finish this and win.
